title: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro
content:
Título

: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro

Fecha

: 1969

Notas

: Título original:

Looking Forward

. Traducido entre 2024-2026 por

La Conquista del Panda

 bajo licencia

CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Fuente

: Obra original recuperada desde

archive.org


Dedicado a las personas jóvenes de todo el mundo que deben afrontar los retos del siglo XXI.


Sobre la obra


 Mirando al futuro es un libro imaginativo y fascinante en el que los autores te llevarán de viaje por la cultura y la tecnología del siglo XXI. Tras una sección introductoria en la que se analiza «lo que moldea nuestro futuro», explorarás los porqués del poco familiar, a veces alarmante, pero apasionante mundo de dentro de cien años.


 Verás esta sociedad a través de los ojos de Scott y Hella, una pareja del próximo siglo. Su vivienda está equipada con un cibernador, un dispositivo informático aparentemente mágico, pero basado en principios científicos hoy conocidos. Ayuda a regular las horas de sueño, las comunicaciones en todo el mundo, un increíble complejo de vida submarina e incluso la ingesta calórica diaria de la «joven» pareja. Son cuarentones, pero pueden esperar vivir 200 años. El mundo en el que viven Scott y Hella es un mundo que ha logrado el control total del clima, que ha desarrollado un ordenador del tamaño de un dedo que se implanta en el cerebro de cada bebé al nacer (y los bebés se incuban científicamente para que las mujeres del siglo XXI no tengan que pasar por los dolores del parto), y que ha perfeccionado la manipulación genética que permite mejorar la especie humana por medio de la ciencia.


 Económicamente, el mundo es utópico para nuestros estándares. Hace tiempo que desaparecieron los empleos, los salarios y el dinero. Nada tiene precio y las posesiones personales no son necesarias. Se ha superado el nacionalismo y se ha logrado el desarme total; la tecnología educativa ha dejado obsoletas las escuelas y los profesores. Los niños aprenden haciendo, y son independientes en este mundo amistoso a los cinco años.


 La principal fuente de esta sociedad mayor es el Centro de Correlación, «Cencor», un gigantesco complejo de ordenadores que sirve a la humanidad, pero nunca la esclaviza. Cencor regula la producción, la comunicación, el transporte y todas las demás tareas onerosas y monótonas del pasado. Esto libera a los seres humanos para que vivan experiencias creativas y estimulantes en lugar de vidas vacías de ocio sin sentido.


 Obviamente, este libro es especulativo, pero está sólidamente basado en los avances científicos que ahora se conocen. Y como dicen los autores:


Entenderás mejor este libro si eres de las que ven el hoy como un peldaño entre el ayer y el mañana.


Necesitarás ser sensible a las injusticias, a las oportunidades de felicidad perdidas y a los agudos conflictos que caracterizan a nuestra civilización del siglo XX. Si tu mente es capaz de sopesar nuevas ideas y evaluarlas con perspicacia, este libro es para ti.


No tenemos una bola de cristal. ...Queremos que introduzcas nuestras ideas en tu propio ordenador, para que puedas encontrar ideas aún mejores que puedan contribuir a moldear el futuro de nuestra civilización.


Sobre los autores


 Jacque Fresco trabajó como diseñador industrial durante treinta años, diseñando todo tipo de equipos, desde casas prefabricadas hasta automóviles, equipos electrónicos y médicos, sistemas de ingeniería ergonómica y cientos de productos comerciales e inventos. Ha diseñado y patentado artículos tan diversos como una estructura de ala de avión revolucionaria, patentada por la USAAF, y películas tridimensionales que no requieren el «uso de gafas especiales». Se han publicado numerosos artículos y fotografías sobre su trabajo en muchas revistas y periódicos. Ha ejercido de asesor técnico en varias películas, incluida una de las primeras sobre estaciones espaciales y un viaje a la Luna titulada «Project Moon Base». Vive en Miami.


 Kenneth S. Keyes, Jr., es un hombre polifacético. Estudió en la Universidad de Duke y se licenció en la Universidad de Miami, con la especialidad principal en psicología y la secundaria en música. Entre sus aficiones se encuentran el arte, la música sinfónica, la navegación a vela —vive a bordo de un yate de 71 pies llamado Caprice— y la escritura; es autor de

Cómo desarrollar tu capacidad de razonamiento

 y

Cómo vivir más tiempo, con más fuerza y más delgado

. Ha impartido clases en la División de Cursos Nocturnos de la Universidad de Miami …

title: Internationale situationniste - Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg
content:
Auteur·e

: Internationale situationniste

Titre

: Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg

Date

: 1967

Notes

: Revue

Internationale situationniste

 n°11, octobre 1967


 Les diverses manifestations de stupeur et d’indignation qui ont fait écho à la brochure situationniste

De la misère en milieu étudiant

, publiée aux frais de la section strasbourgeoise de l’Union Nationale des Étudiants de France, si elles ont eu l’effet opportun de faire lire assez largement les thèses contenues dans la brochure même, ne pouvaient manquer d’accumuler les contresens dans l’exposé et le commentaire de ce qui a été l’activité de l’I.S. en la circonstance. En face des illusions de tous genres entretenues par des journaux, des autorités universitaires, et même un certain nombre d’étudiants irréfléchis, nous allons maintenant préciser ici quelles ont été exactement les conditions de notre intervention, et rappeler quels buts nous poursuivions par les moyens qui nous ont paru y correspondre.


 Plus erronée même que les exagérations de la presse, ou de certains avocats adverses, sur l’ampleur des sommes que l’I.S. aurait saisi l’occasion de piller dans les caisses du malheureux syndicat d’étudiants, se trouve être cette information aberrante, dont les récits journalistiques ont fréquemment fait état, selon laquelle l’I.S. aurait pu s’abaisser à faire campagne devant les étudiants de Strasbourg, pour les persuader de la validité de ses perspectives, et pour faire élire un bureau sur un tel programme. Pas davantage, nous n’avons entrepris le moindre noyautage de l’U.N.E.F., en y glissant secrètement des partisans. Il suffit de nous lire pour comprendre que tels ne peuvent être nos champs d’intérêt, ni nos méthodes. En fait, quelques étudiants de Strasbourg vinrent nous trouver, pendant l’été de 1966, et nous firent savoir que six de leurs amis – et non eux-mêmes – venaient d’être élus comme direction de l’Association étudiante locale (A.F.G.E.S.), sans programme d’aucune sorte, et en dépit du fait qu’ils étaient notoirement connus dans l’U.N.E.F. comme des extrémistes en désaccord complet avec toutes les variantes de sa décomposition, et même résolus à tout casser. Leur élection, au reste tout à fait régulière, manifestait donc à l’évidence et le désintérêt absolu de la base, et l’aveu d’impuissance définitive de ce qui restait de bureaucrates dans cette organisation. Ceux-ci calculaient sans doute que le bureau « extrémiste » ne saurait pas trouver une quelconque expression de ses intentions négatives. C’était inversement la crainte des étudiants qui vinrent alors nous trouver ; et c’est principalement pour ce motif qu’eux-mêmes n’avaient pas cru devoir personnellement figurer dans cette « direction » : car seul un coup d’une certaine ampleur, et non quelque justification humoristique, pouvait sauver ses membres de l’air de compromission que comporte immédiatement un si pauvre rôle. Pour achever la complexité du problème, alors que les étudiants qui nous parlaient connaissaient les positions de l’I.S., et déclaraient les approuver en général, ceux qui étaient membres du bureau les ignoraient plutôt, mais comptaient principalement sur nos interlocuteurs pour définir au mieux l’activité qui pourrait correspondre à leur bonne volonté subversive.


 À ce stade, nous nous sommes bornés à conseiller la rédaction et la publication, par eux tous, d’un texte de critique générale du mouvement étudiant et de la société, un tel travail comportant au moins pour eux l’utilité de leur faire clarifier en commun ce qui leur restait confus. Nous soulignâmes en outre que le fait de disposer d’argent et de crédit était le point essentiel utilisable de la dérisoire autorité qui leur avait été si imprudemment laissée ; et qu’un emploi non-conformiste de ces ressources aurait à coup sûr l’avantage de choquer beaucoup de monde, et par là de faire mieux voir ce qu’ils pourraient mettre de non-conformiste dans le contenu. Ces camarades approuvèrent nos avis. Dans le développement de ce projet, ils restèrent en contact avec l’I.S., particulièrement par l’intermédiaire de Mustapha Khayati.


 La discussion et les premières ébauches de rédaction entreprises collectivement par ceux qui nous avaient rencontrés et les membres du bureau de l’A.F.G.E.S. – tous résolus à mener à bonne fin cette affaire – apportèrent au plan une importante modification. author: Unknown
title: Генри Дэвид Торо - О гражданском неповиновении
content:
Автор

: Генри Дэвид Торо

Название

: О гражданском неповиновении

Дата

: 1849

Дополнительная информация

: Перевод: 3. Е. Александрова

Оригинальное название: "Civil Disobedience"

Источник

: https://biblioteka-online.org/book/o-grazdanskom-nepovinovenii/reader


 Я всецело согласен с утверждением: «лучшее правительство — то, которое правит как можно меньше», — и хотел бы, чтобы оно осуществлялось быстрее и более систематически. Осуществленное, оно сводится в конце концов — и за это я тоже стою — к девизу: Лучшее правительство то, которое не правит вовсе, а когда люди будут к этому готовы, то именно такие правительства у них и будут. Правительство является в лучшем случае всего лишь средством, но большинство правительств обычно—а иногда и все они—являются средствами недейственными. Возражения, приводившиеся против постоянной армии, — а они многочисленны и вески и должны бы восторжествовать — могут быть выдвинуты также и против постоянного правительства. Постоянная армия — это всего лишь рука постоянного правительства. Само правительство, являющееся только формой, в которой народу угодно осуществлять свою волю, тоже ведь может быть обращено во зло, прежде чем народ совершит через него то, что хочет. Доказательством служит нынешняя война в Мексике, затеянная небольшой группой людей, которые использовали постоянное правительство в качестве своего орудия, ибо народ с самого начала не согласился бы на такую меру.


А что такое американское правительство, как не традиция, хотя и недавняя, пытающаяся себя увековечить, но ежеминутно теряющая что-то от своей чистоты? Оно не обладает жизненной силой даже одного человека, ибо один человек может подчинить его своей воле. Для народа это нечто вроде деревянного ружья. Но от этого оно не менее необходимо; ибо народу нужен тот или иной сложный механизм, и притом шумный, чтобы чувствовать, что у него действительно есть правительство. Правительства, таким образом, доказывают, как легко удается для их же пользы обманывать людей и как они обманывают себя сами. Отличная вещь, мы все должны это признать; однако наше правительство еще ни разу само не способствовало никакому делу иначе, как быстро устраняясь с дороги. Не оно охраняет свободу страны. Не оно заселяет Запад. Не оно распространяет просвещение. Все это достигнуто благодаря чертам, присущим американскому народу, и достижений было бы больше, если бы правительство иной раз не мешало этому. Ибо правительство — это средство, с помощью которого люди хотели бы не мешать друг другу, и, как уже было сказано, это средство всегда наиболее действенно, когда меньше всего мешает своим подданным. Если бы торговля не была по своей природе резиновой, она никогда не смогла бы перепрыгивать все препятствия, какие воздвигают на ее пути законодатели; и если бы судить их только по результатам их действий, не учитывая их намерений, их следовало бы карать как тех злоумышленников, которые кладут посторонние предметы на рельсы.


Если говорить конкретно и как гражданин, а не как те, кто отрицает всякое правительство, я требую не немедленной отмены правительства, но его немедленного улучшения. Пусть каждый объявит, какое правительство он готов уважать, и это уже будет шагом к такому правительству.


Когда народ, получив в свои руки власть, передает ее большинству и долгое время позволяет ему править, это происходит не потому, что оно правит наиболее справедливо, и не потому, что это представляется всего справедливее по отношению к меньшинству, но по той простой причине, что оно физически сильнее. Но правительство, где правит большинство, не может быть основано на справедливости даже в том ограниченном смысле, в каком ее понимают люди. Неужели невозможно такое правительство, где о правде и неправде судило бы не большинство, а совесть? Где большинство решало бы лишь те вопросы, к которым приложима мерка целесообразности? Неужели гражданин должен, хотя бы на миг или в малейшей степени, передавать свою совесть в руки законодателя? К чему тогда каждому человеку совесть? Я считаю, что мы должны быть сперва людьми, а потом уж подданными правительства. Желательно воспитывать уважение не столько к закону, сколько к справедливости. Единственная обязанность, какую я имею право на себя брать, — это обязанность всегда поступать так, как мне кажется правильным. Справедливо говорят, что у корпорации нет совести; но корпорация, состоящая из совестливых людей, имеет совесть. Закон никогда еще не делал людей сколько-нибудь справедливее; а из уважения к нему даже …

author: Unknown
title: Voltairine de Cleyre - The Mexican Revolution
content:
Author

: Voltairine de Cleyre

Title

: The Mexican Revolution

Date

: Speech given 29 October 1911, published in Mother Earth 1911-1912

Source

:

www.libertarian-labyrinth.org

, Mother Earth 6 no. 10 (December 1911): 301-306; 6 no. 11 (January 1912): 335-341; 6 no. 12 (February 1912): 374-380.


 THAT a nation of people considering themselves enlightened, informed, alert to the interests of the hour, should be so generally and so profoundly ignorant of a revolution taking place in their backyard, so to speak, as the people of the United States are ignorant of the present revolution in Mexico, can be due only to profoundly and generally acting causes. That people of revolutionary principles and sympathies should be so, is inexcusable.


 It is as one of such principles and sympathies that I address you, as one interested in every move the people make to throw off their chains, no matter where, no matter how, though naturally my interest is greatest where the move is such as appears to me to be most in consonance with the general course of progress, where the tyranny attacked is what appears to me the most fundamental, where the method followed is to my thinking most direct and unmistakable. And I add that those of you who have such principles and sympathies are in the logic of your own being bound, first, to inform yourselves concerning so great a matter as the revolt of millions of people what they are struggling for, what they are struggling against, and how the struggle stands from day to day, if possible; if not, from week to week, or month to month, as best you can; and second, to spread this knowledge among others, and endeavor to do what little you can to awaken the consciousness and sympathy of others.


 One of the great reasons why the mass of the American people know nothing of the Revolution in Mexico, is, that they have altogether a wrong conception of what “revolution” means. Thus ninety-nine out of a hundred persons to whom you broach the subject will say, “Why, I thought that ended long ago. That ended last May”; and this week the press, even the

Daily Socialist

, reports, “A new revolution in Mexico.” It isn’t a

new

 revolution at all; it is the same revolution, which did not begin with the armed rebellion of last May, which has been going on steadily ever since then, and before then, and is bound to go on for a long time to come, if the other nations keep their hands off and the Mexican people are allowed to work out their own destiny.


 What is a revolution? and what is

this

 revolution?


 A revolution means some great and subversive change in the social institutions of a people, whether sexual, religious, political, or economic. The movement of the Reformation was a great religious revolution; a profound alteration in human thought a refashioning of the human mind. The general movement towards political change in Europe and America about the close of the eighteenth century, was a revolution. The American and the French revolutions were only prominent individual incidents in it, culminations of the teachings of the

Rights of Man

.


 The present unrest of the world in its economic relations, as manifested from day to day in the opposing combinations of men and money, in strikes and bread-riots, in literature and movements of all kinds demanding a readjustment of the whole or of parts of our wealth-owning and wealth-distributing system, this unrest is the revolution of our time, the

economic revolution

, which is seeking social change, and will go on until it is accomplished. We are in it; at any moment of our lives it may invade our own homes with its stern demand for self-sacrifice and suffering. Its more violent manifestations are in Liverpool and London to-day, in Barcelona and Vienna to-morrow, in New York and Chicago the day after. Humanity is a seething, heaving mass of unease, tumbling like surge over a slipping, sliding, shifting bottom; and there will never be any ease until a rock bottom of economic justice is reached.


 The Mexican revolution is one of the prominent manifestations of this world-wide economic revolt. It possibly holds as important a place in the present disruption and reconstruction of economic institutions, as the great revolution of France held in the eighteenth century movement. It did not begin with the odious government of Diaz nor end with his downfall, any more than the revolution in France began with the coronation of Louis XVI, or ended with …

author: Unknown
title: Leon Larson - Till narrarna!
content:
Författare

: Leon Larson

Titel

: Till narrarna!

Källa

: Hatets sånger, Leon Larsson, Författarens förlag 1906


 Ni samhällets lekande narrar,

 som lefva i nöjen er dag,

 ni vakna, när samhället darrar,

 och lystra till stormklockans slag.


 Ni trampat med järnskodda sulor

 på slafvarnes stönande bröst,

 med stål och hvinande kulor

 ni gifvit dem lisa och tröst.


 I sekler de hafva förhånats

 och gäckats i armod och nöd;

 på rätten och brödet de rånats:

 ni gifvit dem stenar för bröd.


 Men folken af armodet väckas,

 de minnas de tider, som flytt,

 och hatet, som aldrig kan släckas,

 det flammar och glöder på nytt


 Ja, dårar ni voro, som tänkte.

 att stormen kan aldrig nå hit;

 som fruktan för upproret dränkte

 i nöjen och söfvande sprit.


 Ja, sjungen och skratten, I dårar

 och lefven i nöjen och prakt;

 och svaren de hungrandes tårar

 med käppslag, med hån och förakt.


 Och låt edra sångare sjunga

 för vinet i gyllne pokal;

 må hell-ropen döfvande runga

 och eka i festsmyckad sal.


 Ja, jubla, ni alla, och dansa,

 ty än kan er fest vara glad.

 Och hjässorna kunna ni kransa

 med blommor och grönskande blad.


 Er dans är en dans på vulkanen,

 vid grafven där står eder fest.

 Snart gal nu den blodröda hanen,

 och döden skall vara er gäst.


 I byar, i städernas gränder

 står sinnet hos folket i brand,

 och världen, med stater och länder,

 den står på sin undergångs rand.


 Det blixtrar, det dånar och hviner

 från slafvarnes växande storm.

 Den kommer att slå till ruiner

 ert samhälles åldriga form.


 Försent hör ni stormarna braka

 och ljungeldens dofva krevad,

 men se blott, hur eldarna spraka

 och härja er födelsestad.

author: Unknown
title: Мария Замир - Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?
content:
Автор

: Мария Замир

Название

: Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?

Дата

: 17.06.2026


Слон экоцида: Что убивает Природу?


 Глобальный экоцид – повсеместное уничтожение Природы – это катастрофа, от которой больше нигде нельзя скрыться. Естественная среда под атакой везде: в городах и пригородах, в деревнях и в самых диких лесах, на горных вершинах, в океанах и заповедниках. Этот процесс не останавливается ни на минуту. Мира, каким он был до начала войны с ним цивилизации, больше не существует, а то, что чудом сохранилось в виде оазисов, сейчас безжалостно истребляется. При этом большинство людей не имеют никакого понятия о том, что живут в погибающем мире и что дикой природы почти не осталось, не знают они ничего и о роли биосферы в поддержании жизни. И у них нет никакого желания что-то знать и тем более переживать о судьбе родной планеты. Есть небольшая группа тех, кого волнует гибель Природы, но обычно они видят лишь отдельные проблемы, с которыми и надлежит бороться, такие как строительство на заповедных территориях, загрязнение среды отходами, экологическое невежество населения или беззаконие властей и бизнеса. А само явление глобального экоцида, суть этого смертоносного процесса, охватившего всю Землю, а не частные его проявления, ими не рассматривается.


 Люди, замечающие вокруг себя уничтожение Природы, но не видящие общей картины происходящего – катастрофы планетарного экоцида, – напоминают слепых из древнеиндийской притчи. Пытаясь ответить на вопрос «что такое слон?», каждый из них ощупывает лишь одну часть тела животного, но никто не понимает, что оно представляет собой как целое. Так каков же он как целое – «слон» экоцида? Или, говоря иначе, что происходит со всей планетой, с какой болезнью она столкнулась и в чём её глубинные причины? В чём суть происходящего? Что является двигателем экоцида, если свести все отдельные проблемы к единой основе? Почему уничтожают лес, почему с невиданной скоростью вымирают виды, почему всё завалено пластиком и нет чистых рек, почему даже заповедники находятся под угрозой?


 Здесь уместно вспомнить ещё одного неузнанного слона, на сей раз из английской идиомы «elephant in the room» (дословно «слон в комнате») – о какой-то явной проблеме, которую невозможно не замечать, но о которой присутствующие не говорят, потому что это неприятно или не принято в обществе. Это выражение отлично описывает тот факт, что слона могут не видеть в упор не только слепые, но и вполне зрячие, по крайней мере, физически, и такая умственная слепота возможна для всего социума в целом, что мы и наблюдаем в нашем мире сегодня. Природа исчезает везде, на глазах у всех, но люди этого

не видят

, потому что причина её исчезновения хоть и очевидна, но слишком некомфортна для осознания, а потому о ней не говорят (и не думают).


 Так что это за слон такой в нашей планетарной «комнате»? Что это за деятельность, которая уничтожает Природу каждый день, в любой части мира, и которую упорно «не замечают», предпочитая говорить о зелёных технологиях, устойчивом развитии или экологичном образе жизни? Она настолько привычна, что стала невидимой, как воздух, который везде и о котором никто не думает – им просто дышат и всё. И в то же время она составляет самую суть цивилизации, является первоосновой её существования и главным отличием от природоцентричных культур.


 Деятельность эта –

природозамещение

: замещение Природы цивилизацией и её искусственной оболочкой – техносферой (сферой рукотворных объектов и трансформированных территорий). Эта среда пригодна только для существования в ней человека и глубоко антагонистична по отношению к биосфере, паразитирует на ней и её разрушает.


Замещение Природы собой

 – это то, для чего и чем живет цивилизация, что отражено в повестках, планах и целях всех без исключения стран и обозначается эвфемизмом «хозяйственное освоение территорий», то, чем она определяется и гордится. Любое государство, как и вся цивилизация в целом, – это сверхмощная машина переработки естественных экосистем в техносферу, в мир убитой и переделанной Природы.


 В логике цивилизации на Земле существуют две глобальные системы, потенциально способные управлять жизнью: Природа – то, что было изначально и возникло само по себе, и она сама – структура, созданная человеком. Природа в мифе цивилизации – это сила неразумная, неуправляемая, опасная, бесцельная, совершенно непригодная для жизни человечества в своем нетрансформированном виде и вдобавок к этому – некомфортная, неудобная, не ставящая …

title: Mazlum Abdi Şara'ya danışman olarak atandı
content:

Suriye resmi haber ajansı SANA'nın haberinde "Cumhurbaşkanı Ahmed Şara 2026 tarihli ve 164 sayılı kararnameyle Mustafa Halil Abdi'yi (Mazlum Abdi) Cumhurbaşkanlığı nezdinde danışman olarak atamıştır" ifadeleri yer aldı.

HTŞ yönetimi ile görüşmelere katılan İlham Ahmed, The Amargi’ye verdiği demeçte kendisinin ve Abdi’nin devlet bünyesinde yeni görevler üstleneceğini açıklamıştı. Buna göre, Abdi’nin Kürt işlerinden sorumlu Cumhurbaşkanı danışmanlığına, Ahmed’in ise Halk Meclisi olarak adlandırılan parlamento yönetimine atanarak Kürt sorunu dosyasıyla ilgileneceği aktarılmıştı.

author: Unknown
title: Bakan Yumaklı'dan orman yangını uyarısı: Önümüzdeki 3 gün kritik
content:
Fotoğraf: İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi

Ankara – Tarım ve Orman Bakanı İbrahim Yumaklı, 28-30 Ağustos tarihlerinde Marmara, Ege ve Batı Akdeniz’de kuvvetli rüzgâr, yüksek sıcaklık ve düşük nem nedeniyle orman yangını riskinin artacağını belirterek vatandaşları dikkatli olmaları konusunda uyardı.

Yumaklı, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, meteorolojik verilere göre önümüzdeki üç günün orman yangınları açısından kritik olduğunu bildirdi.

Marmara, Ege ve Batı Akdeniz’de beklenen hava koşullarının yangın riskini artıracağını belirten Yumaklı, ormanlık alanlarda ve yakın çevresinde ateş yakılmaması, kuru otluk alanlara yanıcı madde atılmaması, anız ve bahçe atığı yakılmaması uyarısında bulundu.

Yumaklı, en küçük duman veya şüpheli durumun 112 Acil Çağrı Merkezi’ne bildirilmesini isteyerek, “En büyük gücümüz vatandaşlarımızın duyarlılığı ile yangın çıkmasını önlemektir” dedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: YPJ announces the death of three fighters who fell during Afrin resistance in 2018
content:
The General Command of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) issued a written statement announcing the martyrdom of three of their fighters.


According to the statement, Êlêm Cûdî, Slava Kurdistan, and Êlêm Çiya fought until their last breaths in Afrin in 2018 to defend their land and the dignity of their people.


The YPJ obituary on Thursday includes the following:


"We are living through a historic period in which every inch of our land is safeguarded by the blood of the heroes of our freedom. Throughout history, women have led and contributed to great achievements, engraving their names in our movement in letters of gold. Today, the pioneering role of women freedom fighters has become an enduring reality. Our comrades Êlêm Cûdî, Slava Kurdistan, and Êlêm Çiya struggled until their last breaths to defend our land and the dignity of our people, attaining martyrdom at different times and in different places. We extend our deepest condolences to the architect of free life, Leader Apo (Abdullah Öcalan), to the families of our esteemed comrades, and to all members of our freedom-loving people.


In the struggle for freedom, every comrade who joins the ranks of resistance leaves her mark on the history of our people through determination and perseverance.


Our comrade Êlêm Cûdî was among those immortal heroines who advanced to the front lines with unwavering determination. She was raised in a patriotic family and was deeply imbued with the culture and values of her homeland. She believed that defending Afrin meant defending the dignity of humanity. Inspired by the spirit of sacrifice embodied by her comrades, she became a symbol of resistance, standing with an iron will in the face of the invaders’ most advanced technologies. Through her commitment to the struggle and her courage, Comrade Êlêm Cûdî secured a place in the hearts of all her comrades, giving those around her strength and courage during the most difficult times. She was not merely a fighter; she was also a defender of the values of freedom, equality, and a dignified life. Her struggle against oppression and darkness became a beacon illuminating our path of resistance. Comrade Êlêm Cûdî joined the caravan of immortals in an airstrike carried out by the occupying Turkish state on the Mabata area of Afrin on 14 March 2018.


In the Kurdish people’s struggle for freedom, the resistance of Afrin became a symbol of the struggle for existence and dignity against fascism and occupation. Within this steadfast stronghold of resistance, our comrade Êlêm Çiya, through her sacrifice and intellectual awareness, inscribed her name upon the rocks of Mount Kurmênc as a symbol of Apo’s struggle. Comrade Êlêm embraced freedom as a philosophy of life and social renewal, walking in the spirit of the free woman and democratic society. During the most difficult moments of the invading Turkish army’s attacks, her faith in the importance of defending the sacred land grew stronger, and she adopted an unwavering stance of sacrifice. Raised on the land of Afrin and deeply rooted in its rich culture of resistance, she made national values the foundation of her life of struggle. Her martyrdom became the beginning of a growing struggle for retribution. Our comrade Êlêm Çiya joined the caravan of martyrs during the resistance of Afrin in February 2018.


There is no doubt that the resistance of Afrin in 2018 stands among the most glorious and honorable chapters of this history. Our heroic comrade Slava Kurdistan was among the immortal, shining stars of that resistance. Comrade Slava was a steadfast woman, deeply devoted to the land of Afrin, dedicating every moment of her life to the freedom of her people and the dignity of women. She refused to accept occupation and slavery. When it came to defending the dignity of Afrin, she confronted the most brutal forms of violence with an iron will, a mind guided by freedom, and a self-sacrificing heart. Comrade Slava Kurdistan joined the caravan of immortals on the sacred land of Afrin, demonstrating through her martyrdom that the will of free women and the Kurdish people’s longing for freedom can be realized through struggle. Her life has become an example and an inspiration to thousands of young people who follow in her footsteps today. Our comrade Slava Kurdistan joined the caravan of martyrs in an airstrike carried out by the occupying Turkish state on 9 March 2018 on the village of Kafr Safri, in the district of Jindires, in the Afrin region …

title: Meeting in Damascus proposes integration of the YPJ as a distinct and organized force
content:
On 26 August, the General Command of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) held a meeting with an official delegation from the Ministry of Interior of the transitional government in Damascus.


During the meeting, issues of security and stability in Syria, as well as the future of cooperation and coordination between the two sides, were discussed extensively.


The future of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) was the main focus of the meeting. It was emphasized that the YPJ could be integrated, as a distinct and organized force, into the structure of the Ministry of Interior.


“The meeting was held in a positive and constructive atmosphere. In order to complete and finalize the integration process within the framework of the 29 January 2026 Agreement, our meetings and discussions will continue,” the YPJ General Command stated.

title: Memorial ceremony for three YPJ fighters in Heseke
content:
A solemn memorial ceremony was held in the city of Heseke in honor of three women fighters of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ), who sacrificed their lives and wrote the highest meanings of heroism with their blood.


The symbolic funeral ceremony was organized to honor Silava Kurdistan (Îman Mihemed Mustefa), who fell on March 9, 2018; Eylem Cûdî (Fatma Mihemed Mustefa), who fell on March 14, 2018; and Eylem Çiya (Ranya Ferîd Ehmed), who fell during the resistance in Afrin in February 2018.


Hundreds of local residents and community dignitaries gathered at the Martyr Dijwar Cemetery.


The ceremony began with a solemn moment of silence in tribute to the women martyrs who have left us, while their memory remains forever alive in the conscience of the homeland.


At the conclusion of this moving ceremony, the Council of Martyrs’ Families came forward to read the martyrs’ commemorative documents. The documents were read in heartfelt words that reflected the depth of the loss and the greatness of their sacrifice, before being presented to the families of the women martyrs in a scene where tears of farewell mingled with pride and belonging.


This ceremony was an unforgettable tribute of loyalty, affirming that the sacrifices of these women fighters will remain a beacon for future generations and a symbol of heroism that will never fade.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Oz Dismisses Measles Concerns as “Inappropriate” After Baby Dies in Pennsylvania
content:
“I don’t want anyone in America concerned inappropriately” about the surging disease, the health official said.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Medicare and Medicaid Services administrator Mehmet Oz downplayed the GOP-fueled surge in measles infections after Pennsylvania officials announced that a newborn baby died with complications related to the disease this week.

On Wednesday, the Pennsylvania Department of Health revealed that one of the two measles-related deaths in Lancaster County this week was of a newborn baby. Both individuals were unvaccinated, and their deaths marked the first recorded deaths related to measles this year in the U.S.

Measles cases have risen to over 2,700 so far this year, the highest level in decades. The disease had been declared eliminated in the U.S. in 2000 due mostly to the effective measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination program. Disinformation about vaccines spread by the Trump administration and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is driving the rise in measles cases, according to experts.

Trump administration official Mehmet Oz claimed, however, that the fears of measles are overblown.

“I don’t want anyone in America concerned inappropriately” about the disease, said Oz on Fox News. “We don’t know exactly what happened in Pennsylvania yet. We don’t know if the children died from measles or they had another condition that was already attacking them and they happened to get measles at the same time.”

Oz said that this is a common practice when attributing deaths related to COVID-19 during the pandemic — when many people died from pneumonia infections that were worsened by and often outright brought on by COVID infections.

This is a highly misleading comment. In announcing the deaths, Pennsylvania officials specified that the deaths were “associated” with measles. The county coroner found that the baby died from laceration of the spleen — which Children’s Hospital of Pennsylvania pediatrician and vaccine safety expert Paul Offit said can be a side effect of a measles infection. Offit told the Philadelphia Inquirer that measles can cause the spleen to be enlarged, and that birth can cause the spleen to rupture.

The coroner, Stephen Diamantoni, said that the pathologist who conducted the autopsy “did not feel it was related to measles.”

Offit said that the coroner should give another explanation for the spleen rupture if it weren’t caused by measles, and further said he has had conversations with state health officials that made it clear that the “patients would not have died were it not for measles.” He added that attributing deaths to something other than measles is a common tactic of anti-vaccine advocates like those in the Trump administration.

After the deaths, Kennedy claimed, without evidence, that Pennsylvania officials announced the deaths for political reasons. He even went as far to say that “deaths may even have been altogether fabricated by one of [Gov. Josh Shapiro’s] hopeful staffers.”

Pennsylvania Health Secretary Debra Bogen said that Kennedy’s statements are untrue, and that the deaths were announced after thorough investigation to verify that both patients were infected with measles — a highly contagious and dangerous illness that had an 11 percent hospitalization rate in 2025, and a 7 percent rate in the U.S.

Of measles patients this year, 93 percent are unvaccinated or their vaccination status is unknown. Most of these cases have been among children, who are the worst affected by the disease.

The measles outbreak may soon get worse. Earlier this month, President Donald Trump signed an executive order to recommend that the MMR vaccine be split into three separate shots, citing an old, thoroughly debunked claim that the vaccine causes autism. Health experts say that this may reduce uptake of vaccinations against measles, as new vaccines would have to be developed, and splitting them up may further discourage families from trusting the shot.

Amid this move, The New York Times resurfaced a claim made by Kennedy in remarks to a large crowd in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, in 2021. At that event, he joked that his childhood measles infection allowed him to “stay home and watch TV the whole week.”

“The cure for measles is chicken soup and vitamin A,” he said, in a complete lie.

author: Jesse Staniforth
title: Long Point First Nation leadership grateful court acknowledged intimidation
content:
The leadership of Long Point First Nation praised the Court of Quebec for its handling of the case of a man from a neighbouring community accused of threatening Chief Steeve Mathias.


Judge Nathalie Samson prohibited Éric Bélanger from coming within a two-kilometer radius of the First Nation, which is located in the Winneway Indian Settlement in Quebec’s Abitibi-Timiskaming region, about 560 km north of Peterborough, Ont. She also barred Bélanger from communicating with or contacting Chief Mathias, or his daughter and grandchildren, or from possessing firearms for 12 months.


Bélanger is from the neighbouring community of Laforce, Que. According to the CBC, Mathias alleged in his testimony that Bélanger came to his residence after Long Point’s band council banned him from entering the community and told Mathias that “no one could stop him” from visiting the territory. He allegedly also told Mathias he owned 115 guns. Bélanger was not present for the decision.


“The Court’s willingness to listen and its consideration send an important message to the community,” Long Point’s band council said in a press release, “as well as to those who profit from the trafficking of illegal drugs and other criminal activities in Winneway: the harm caused to families, youth, and the community as a whole cannot be ignored.”


The council added that the court decision was an important step toward accountability that made clear that intimidation and acts that endanger community members would be taken seriously.


Long Point’s council stressed that the community has gone 20 years without police services, since the dissolution of its Indigenous police force in 2006.


“The community is coping with police coverage it considers insufficient and ill-suited to its reality, particularly given what it says is an increased presence of organized crime,” the council said in a press release ahead of the court date.


A show of solidarity


Mathias was joined by a group of community members at the courthouse in Ville-Marie, near Quebec’s border with Ontario. The group hoped to send a message about the importance of security in the community, where many people say the lack of police coverage leaves them feeling unsafe.


Long Point’s council said in its first release that the group wanted to remind the government that all discussions about police coverage affect the safety of people and families. In it second release, council noted Judge Samson acknowledged the presence of the group supporting their chief and expressing their concerns about safety.


“Today, elders, parents, youth and families have chosen to be here together,” Chief Mathias said ahead of the court appearance. “Their presence sends a simple message: we want to feel safe in our own homes, and we want to be heard. We want our children to be able to grow up safely, for our elders to feel protected and for our families to know that when they ask for help, someone will respond. We need concrete action.”


Read more:


Indigenous police forces struggling to keep up MPs told 


Chiefs upset after Quebec cuts ‘unsatisfactory’ meeting on policing short


Following the decision by Judge Samson, council said in a statement that they hoped “this recognition will mark a turning point and remind the governments of Quebec and Canada of the urgent need to implement a sustainable solution so that Winneway members can benefit from adequate police services and live safely in their community.”


Mathias added that Long Point has been asking governments to ensure the safety of the community for over 20 years.


“All too often,” he said, “we have felt that our voices were not being heard. Yesterday, for once, an institution clearly acknowledged our fears and took action to protect our community. We felt that the Court stood with us to ensure our safety. We are deeply grateful to it.”


Respect for Anicinabek tradition


Mathias also expressed gratitude toward Judge Samson, who allowed him to take his oath on an eagle feather.


“What happened at the courthouse is very important to me and to our community,” Mathias said. “Being able to take the oath on an eagle feather, in accordance with our traditions, is a gesture of respect that deeply moved us. We felt that the court was listening to us, that it understood our fears, and that it respected who we are as Anicinabek. It is gestures like these that contribute in a concrete and meaningful way to reconciliation.”

author: The Canadian Press
title: Who gets to name a lake? What to know about Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario
content:
The name of one of the Great Lakes has become the latest target of U.S. President Donald Trump’s ire after trade talks with Canada broke down less than a week ago.


Trump signed an executive order on Thursday to change the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America. The move came two days after he said on his social media platform Truth Social he was “giving serious consideration” to the idea.


Ontario Premier Doug Ford and Trump exchanged personal insults over the tariff war earlier in the week.


The threat to rename the Great Lake that borders Ontario and New York came right after Ford and Trump targeted one another with insults.


The premier called Trump a bully and told him to “kiss my ass,” and the president retaliated by saying Ford is a less charismatic version of his late brother, the controversial former Toronto mayor Rob Ford.


Trump repeatedly posted about Canada on Tuesday, repeating claims that the country was “ripping off” the United States.


The president added that his country doesn’t expect to continue doing business with Ontario “much longer.”


He also posted an image of a map of Lake Ontario with its name crossed out and replaced with Lake America.


Ford has since toned down his language, instead encouraging both sides to reach a deal, though he said he doesn’t regret his words because they resonated around the world.


How did Lake Ontario get its name?


The name is older than Canada itself.


Historians believe Lake Ontario’s name has Iroquoian roots meaning “beautiful lake” or “sparkling water,” according to the Canadian Encyclopedia.


Europeans began calling the lake “Ontario” in 1641, the encyclopedia entry says, and by 1656 the name was appearing on maps.


The province of Ontario is named after the lake.


The Geographical Names Board of Canada formed in 1897, and its members have approved more than 350,000 place names over the course of its existence.


People and organizations can propose new names for Canadian geography.


To put in a request, the naming board needs information including reasons for the suggested name change, the origin and meaning of the name, contact information for local residents who can verify how the space is used and photos or sketches.


Canada does not have to recognize name changes made by other countries.


Even if Trump succeeds in renaming Lake Ontario on the U.S. side, he can’t dictate what the rest of the world calls it.


What other places has Trump renamed-or tried to?


One of Trump’s first moves after his inauguration in January 2025 was signing an executive order to change the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America.


The Gulf of Mexico has carried its name for more than 400 years, and Trump’s order only holds water in the United States.


Trump also signed an executive order to change the name of North America’s tallest peak back to Mount McKinley.


Former president Barack Obama changed the official name to Denali in 2015, the preference of local residents and Indigenous Peoples.


But Trump said in his executive order that he wanted to “restore the name of a great president, William McKinley, to Mount McKinley.”


— With files from The Associated Press

Who gets to name a lake? What to know about Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario

author: Chris Walker
title: Air Force Major Faces Rare Charges After Calling for Trump’s Impeachment
content:
Maj. Jason Watson faces charges relating to alleged “contemptuous” statements he made against the president.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

The United States Air Force has issued multiple charges against a decorated airman over his public statements earlier this summer calling for the impeachment of President Donald Trump.

In addition to Trump, Major Jason Watson also called for Vice President J.D. Vance’s impeachment during a demonstration outside the U.S. Capitol building on July 2. He reiterated his demands for impeachment in subsequent interviews afterward.

Watson’s lawyer, Christopher Mutimer, indicated on Tuesday that the airman is facing possible charges relating to the Uniform Code of Military Justice. The Air Force later confirmed that those charges had been issued, and that Watson was being held in pre-trial confinement.

Watson’s arrest at the U.S. Capitol in early July occurred during a protest involving multiple organizations and speakers who were critical of the White House’s decision to start a war in Iran without congressional authorization and other military actions. Watson held a sign at that event that read, “impeach, convict, remove.”

“When the president of the United States orders military action against foreign countries — absent an emergency scenario where American interests are under imminent dire threats, as was done with Venezuela, Cuba and Iran — that’s an unconstitutional usurpation of Congress’s authority and a violation of the War Powers Clause,” Watson said at the event.

Rules of the U.S. Capitol stipulate that protests on the steps of the building can only occur when individuals are accompanied by a federal lawmaker. When Rep. Al Green (D-Texas) had to leave in the middle of the demonstration, Capitol Police detained Watson for breaking those rules.

The Air Force has indicated that Watson has been charged with 10 violations under three sections of the Uniform Code of Military Justice. Those include claims that he violated Article 92 of the provision (engaging in dereliction of duty) and Article 133 (actions unbecoming of an officer).

Watson, who has served in the Air Force for nearly two decades, also faces unusual charges relating to Article 88 of the code, a little-used provision that forbids “contemptuous words against the President, the Vice President, [and] Congress.” According to Mutimer, Watson is the first major in U.S. military history to face charges under that article.

A conviction under that provision could be difficult to prove, as the military would have to demonstrate that Watson’s words weren’t just critical of Trump and Vance, but also made out of contempt for them — that is, out of hate or purposeful disrespect.

The high burden of proof to convict Watson could turn the case into a free speech issue — while members of the military are not protected as strongly under the provisions of the First Amendment, they are not completely deprived of their speech rights under military regulations.

If convicted, Watson could be dismissed from the Air Force, and could lose future benefits that would have been afforded to him, including his retirement. He could also face the possibility of imprisonment.

Responding to the charges against his client, Mutimer said that “Major ​Watson acted knowing the risks to his career and his liberty.”

“It is my hope that other Americans who feel powerless in this moment will take some measure of courage from his willingness to speak and to stand ​by his convictions,” Mutimer added.

As Trump cracks down on political speech, independent media is increasingly necessary.

Truthout produces reporting you won’t see in the mainstream: journalism from the frontlines of global conflict, interviews with grassroots movement leaders, high-quality legal analysis and more.

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Nunavik police relaunch cadet program to build Inuit workforce
content:
Nunavik Police Service has relaunched its cadet program with the goal of increasing its Inuit staff and providing learning opportunities for young people.


The eight-month program will recruit youth from ages 12 to 20 in Kuujjuaq to participate in various activities related to policing, survival skills, first-aid, and fitness training, said program co-ordinator Jessica Ashcroft in a French interview.


Former police chief Jean-Pierre Larose announced in March 2025 that the

program

 would return after its last run, launched in 2018, was abandoned.


The program didn’t return last summer as anticipated, according to Ashcroft, who was hired in October, and said the delay might have been due to change in police leadership and a desire to develop a strong program.


Jean-François Bernier

took over

 as chief of Nunavik Police Service in November 2025.


The new program is intended to go beyond exposing young people to police work, Ashcroft said.


“We want a program that accompanies them, that supports them,” she said. “The problems we have had in the past, we’ve learned from them and we don’t repeat them.”


The program will be divided into three age groups: 12 to 14, 15 to 17, and 18 to 20.


The cadets will meet every Tuesday for an in-class session following a curriculum that will introduce them to policing and cover topics such as first aid and other skills.


Ashcroft said she has partnered with Saqijuq, which offers cultural and traditional programming, to organize land-based activities such as hunting and fishing for the cadets.


“We want a more representative police force, but we want to also maintain cultural identity,” Ashcroft said.


She said she’s also working to give Inuit officers more support for their well being. She said former cadets who went on to become police officers sometimes encountered difficulties while responding to calls in their communities.


“One of the problems in the past was that previous traumas would resurface. They’d arrive at calls and relive things they’d experienced themselves, things they hadn’t yet dealt with,” she said.


She’s working on putting together a team to offer sessions on stress management, anxiety symptoms recognition, and prevention.


“Maybe eventually, if some of them are open to it, I’d like to have one-on-one support.”


Ashcroft said she hopes the program’s broader approach will help build trust and encourage more young people to consider policing as a career while remaining connected to their community and culture.


”If the goal is community policing, it’s about having the young people help at events, doing activities, and speaking to elders,” she said.


“It’s about being visible around the community.”

author: The Canadian Press
title: Elections BC allows petition bid for Indigenous law’s repeal to proceed
content:
Elections BC says it has granted in-principle approval for a petition to proceed seeking the repeal of British Columbia’s

Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act

.


The petition’s proponent is Harman Bhangu, transportation critic for the provincial Opposition B.C. Conservatives.


The law, known as DRIPA, is designed to affirm the application of the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples into B.C. laws, but has become a flashpoint for critics.


Premier David Eby backed down on a plan to suspend the law in April amid strong opposition from many First Nations leaders who support it.


The petition requires signatures of 10 per cent of voters in all 93 electoral districts by Jan. 25, 2027, to succeed, resulting in referral to the legislature, but is not a binding process.


Chief electoral officer Shipra Verma says in her reasons for approval that she is satisfied the matter that is within the jurisdiction of the legislature, and the proposed draft bill on the repeal is clear and unambiguous.


The announcement on Thursday says if the petition is referred to the legislative assembly, next steps could include recommending introduction of the draft bill or referring the petition and bill for a vote.


The proposed two-sentence repeal bill says the repeal would come into force upon royal assent.


A B.C. Appeal Court ruling last year found that provincial mining rules were inconsistent with DRIPA, spurring concerns about the broad impact of the legislation.


Elections BC says it has approved 14 initiative petitions since 1995, and only one, the 2010 petition to reverse the harmonized sales tax, met the requirements.

author: Paul Prescod
title: Jackson Transit Workers Win Strike, Save Saturday Service
content:
Eighty public transit workers in Jackson, Mississippi, have won a tentative agreement with MV Transportation, after a

grueling five-week strike

. The transit workers represented by ATU Local 1208 garnered public support and were able to win most of their major demands.


One of their most important victories was that they fought off a proposal for microtransit, a form of private on-call transit service that would have brought in drivers without a commercial driver’s license at a lower-tier wage. Besides the fact that microtransit is much less reliable for riders with disabilities, the union felt it needed to take a stand on principle against the introduction of a two-tier wage system.


There were other wins for riders in the contract. JTRAN workers were able to stop cuts to Saturday service and the elimination of two bus routes. Throughout the strike the riding public was supportive, bringing water and food to support strikers on the picket line. A snow cone truck even made the trip from Tennessee to help them cool off in the heat.


The union also struck a blow against an unfair disciplinary system where many drivers were getting terminated for minor infractions. The new agreement includes a two-person accident review board with representatives from the union and the company. Originally, MV Transportation was pushing to stack the deck with two company representatives.


Importantly in the state with the highest poverty rate, workers won a 5 percent across the board wage increase. Early in negotiations the company had agreed to this increase for new hires, but proposed a much lower increase for high-seniority drivers.


One big issue the union still did not win was guaranteed breaks for drivers. (Neither federal law nor Mississippi state law requires meal or rest breaks.) This will be a priority for the next contract, which expires on December 31, 2028.

author: Secretariat
title: Sobre la información falsa acerca de la «refundación de la AIT»
content:
A principios de este mes, la organización española de la Confederación Internacional del Trabajo (CIT), organización internacional que apoya la integración con los sindicatos marxistas-leninistas y verticales, publicó información falsa afirmando que: “La CIT nace de una refundación de la histórica Asociación


Internacional de los Trabajadores (AIT), tras la expulsión de varios de sus sindicatos miembros en 2016.” Desmentimos esta información por considerarla deliberadamente engañosa. La AIT jamás ha votado a favor de su refundación, y dicha propuesta nunca se ha presentado ante un Congreso de la AIT para su


debate. Como organización internacional basada en los principios del horizontalismo —es decir, la toma de decisiones por parte de sus miembros en sus Congresos—, ninguna decisión de este tipo podría adoptarse sin pasar por los procedimientos orgánicos de la AIT.


La AIT ha aclarado este asunto en numerosas ocasiones, pese a que la organización española de la CIT insiste en mantener esta mentira.


La CIT surgió de los esfuerzos de tres sindicatos que antes formaban parte de la AIT, los cuales habían desarrollado estructuras organizativas y directivas no orgánicas para unirse a organizaciones similares que permitieran el ejecucionismo y otras prácticas que no se ajustaban a las tácticas y objetivos de la AIT. Al


intentar dividir la AIT y formar otra internacional, negándose a participar orgánicamente en ella, se autoexcluyeron y fueron desafiliados.


Estas son algunas de las decisiones del XXVI Congreso de la AIT celebrado en 2016:


«La AIT determina como ilegítimos cualesquiera intentos de la CNTE desfederada o la USI desfederada a representar a la AIT, autodenominarse AIT o “relanzar” la AIT».


„Cualesquiera intentos de “relanzar” la AIT, reorganizarla, etc. etc., que se tomen fuera de los procedimientos orgánicos de la AIT, deben ser considerados inorgánicos y tratados como intentos de apoderarse y usurpar la Internacional. En cualquier situación en la que alguna organización haga una convocatoria pública con este fin, se debe emitir un comunicado explicando que no está respaldada por la AIT. author: Jake Johnson
title: RFK Jr. Says SNAP Cuts Won’t Have “That Much Effect.” 5 Million Have Lost Aid.
content:
SNAP enrollment nationwide has fallen to a 17-year low following enactment of the Trump-GOP budget law.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

US Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Wednesday dismissed the impact of massive food aid cuts signed into law last summer by President Donald Trump, saying he doesn’t believe the cuts will have “that much effect” as new data showed at least 5 million people have lost assistance so far — including roughly 1.5 million children.

Speaking at a news conference on children’s nutrition in Florida, Kennedy falsely claimed that “the only people kicked off of” the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) under the GOP budget law signed by Trump “were people who were not eligible for it,” either “because their income is too high or because they were illegal aliens.”

Kennedy’s remarks came as a new analysis by the Center on Budget and Policy Priorities (CBPP) found that SNAP enrollment nationwide has fallen to a 17-year low following enactment of the Trump-GOP budget law, which will cut the program by around $190 billion over the next decade, enact stricter work reporting mandates, and require states to contribute a portion of benefit costs for the first time.

“’Not much effect?’ Based on available data from 25 states, we estimate that well over 1.5 million kids nationwide have lost SNAP in the wake of the unprecedented cuts in the Republican reconciliation law,” Katie Bergh, a policy analyst at CBPP, wrote in response to Kennedy’s remarks. “Many of those kids and their families lost SNAP despite still being eligible.”

Q: “Are either of you concerned that the reduction in funding for SNAP and the reduction in eligibility for SNAP will reduce access to food for children and families?” Sec. Kennedy: “I don't think it's gonna have that much effect.” pic.twitter.com/1h97NP6rcN

News reports, anecdotal accounts from impacted families, and expert assessments contradict Kennedy’s insistence that only those who were no longer eligible for SNAP due to income or immigration status have lost benefits. An explosion of red tape due to the new work reporting requirements imposed by the Trump-GOP budget law has made it more difficult for eligible beneficiaries to continue receiving SNAP, forcing many to seek aid from food banks and take desperate measures — such as skipping meals and doses of medication — to make ends meet.

CBPP warned that the impacts of the cuts are likely to intensify once the budget law’s provision shifting benefit costs to states takes full effect next year.

“The magnitude of the cost shift and the urgency surrounding error rates may incentivize states to take drastic measures to reduce their payment error rates quickly and cut program costs, even if it means delaying or improperly denying benefits to eligible people,” the think tank said on Wednesday. “We’re likely seeing some of those initial effects in SNAP participation data.”

A report published last month by a pair of food policy experts argued that the unprecedented assault on SNAP undercuts Kennedy’s so-called “Make America Healthy Again” initiative, which purports to place nutrition “at the center of health.”

“If we are serious about improving Americans’ health, we need policies that make healthy food more accessible, not less,” said Priya Fielding-Singh of George Washington University’s Global Food Institute. “Cutting off food assistance for millions of families undermines MAHA’s stated goals of improving diet quality and preventing chronic disease. Food security and public health go hand in hand.”

author: Michael Arria
title: Abdul El-Sayed’s Win Sparked a Wave of Islamophobia Across Social Media
content:
One group found a twentyfold increase in anti-Muslim posts after the primary and says the surge has not subsided.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Abdul El-Sayed’s victory in Michigan generated a wave of Islamophobia across social media.

That’s the conclusion of a recent Washington Post study and several similar recent investigations, which find that El-Sayed’s religion became the main target of right-wing critics after he won the state’s Democratic Senate nomination and positioned himself to take on the GOP nominee, Mike Rogers, this fall.

According to the paper’s analysis, almost 1 in 3 posts about El-Sayed from right-wing figures mentioned Islam, Muslims, or Sharia Law, within 2 weeks of his August 4 victory.

This included far-right pundits like Laura Loomer, who referred to El-Sayed as a jihadist, and GOP lawmakers, like Sen. Tommy Tuberville (R-AL) who declared that the former public health official could be the first “TERRORIST” to join the Senate.

In a post on X, former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo claimed that El-Sayed is a “Hamas supporter” who could help send the United States down a “truly dark road” if Americans don’t “wake up to this threat.”

On Truth Social, President Donald Trump posted a photo of himself with the First Lady, juxtaposed with an image of El-Sayed with his wife, who wears a hijab. “Two VERY DIFFERENT America’s [sic],” reads the image.

In an article on this recent wave of Islamophobia, The New York Times points out that Republicans frequently refer to El-Sayed by his entire name, Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, in an effort to stoke further xenophobia.

“Few officials in the Republican Party have publicly tried to tamp down such messaging,” notes the paper.

The attacks on El-Sayed certainly aren’t occurring in a vacuum.

On August 19, over 20 people were arrested in Dearborn, Michigan, after fascist provocateurs descended on the building where the city council holds its meetings. The “Christian Crusader March” was led by Jake Lang, who served four years in prison for his role in the January 6 insurrection before being pardoned by Trump. It was the third time that the anti-Muslim activist had shown up in the predominantly Arab-American city to rail against the religion.

Earlier this month, Texas Governor Greg Abbott ordered a review of airports in Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) and Houston “for possible revocation of active state grant funds,” over plans to build washing stations for Islamic pre-prayer ablution. The DFW airport immediately ditched the proposal in response to the threat.

The Council on American–Islamic Relations (CAIR) referred to the move as an “anti-Muslim political stunt.”

“Of all the silly controversies that [Abbott] has manufactured about Muslims over the past year, the airport washing station outrage might be the most ridiculous. And hypocritical,” said the group in a statement.

In another analysis, Al Jazeera found that El-Sayed’s win ignited a “coordinated digital smear campaign,” which began with right-wing pundit Benny Johnson clipping the phrase “inshallah” (which means, “God willing”) from his election night speech.

The investigation found that the campaign spread across 1,966 accounts and more than 2,500 connections in its first 24 hours. “The far-right narrative spread rapidly as political figures and pro-Israel organisations joined the debate,” notes the site.

The Center for the Study of Organized Hate (CSOH) found a twentyfold increase in anti-Muslim posts after the Michigan primary and says the surge has not subsided. On X, the summer’s highest single day of anti-Muslim bigotry occurred on the day after the election.

“These campaigns draw on conspiracy theories about Muslim religious practices, mosques, and the supposed imposition of ‘Sharia law,’ all reinforcing a broader narrative of an impending Muslim takeover,” concludes the study, which notes that a similar uptick in Islamophobic posts after Zohran Mamdani was elected mayor of New York City. “This narrative echoes the Great Replacement theory and intensifies around major events, including conflicts in the Middle East and the growing visibility of Muslims running for public office.”

Mike Rodgers, El-Sayed’s opponent, has also leaned into these narratives, claiming that El-Sayed is “UnAmerican” and antisemitic.

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: PM Considers Blocking Imports From Illegal Israeli Settlements
content:
Andy Burnham is considering banning the trade in goods and services linked to illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank.


A ban would be the strongest response yet by the UK government in response to Israel’s escalation of settler violence and displacement of Palestinian communities.

YouGov polling

 shows that 50% of British people would back such a ban, compared with 16% who would oppose it.


The potential ban comes after Israel

opened up bidding for construction

 of 1,200 new settler homes in the E1 area of the occupied West Bank. Foreign secretary Ed Miliband

condemned the project

 as a threat to a two-state solution, which would split the West Bank in two and separate Palestinian communities from East Jerusalem. 


Labour has come under internal pressure to take action against Israeli settlements since June, with more than 140 Labour MPs – around a third of the parliamentary party –

signing a letter

calling for a trade ban with illegal settlements.


The

government said

 it would “set out a comprehensive set of measures” in the coming weeks in response. But it faces strong opposition from advocacy group Labour Friends of Israel (LFI), which claims that a trade ban could become a “de facto boycott” of Israel.


LFI, which counts many of Burnham’s cabinet ministers as current or former members, has argued that the ban “would be deeply damaging to the UK national interest, the British Jewish community and Palestinian workers”.


However, Chris Doyle, director of the Council for Arab-British Understanding (CAABU), described the LFI’s position as “a disgrace”. 


“Just because Israel makes it hard to tell which are Israeli goods and which are settlement goods is not the UK’s problem. It is Israel’s,”

he wrote on X

. “You do not get to export proceeds of crime just because the criminal party mixes the legal with the illegal.”


Several other European governments have already taken steps to implement sanctions against Israel. In July, the Irish government passed a bill banning goods imports from illegal Israeli settlements, while France and Sweden recently called on the European Union to increase tariffs and enforce stricter controls on goods from occupied Palestinian territories.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Pilot program aims to make policy ‘less intimidating’ to Indigenous youth
content:
For Indigenous youth in Iqaluit who find policy intimidating, a new program aims to make the world of decision-making more accessible.


Arnatsiaq Qvist, a Northern Policy School specialist with Indigenous Youth Roots, will help facilitate the Iqaluit program, which will include a focus on Nunavut-specific land claims and policy issues. (Photo courtesy of Arnatsiaq Qvist)


The Northern Policy School, developed by national non-profit organization Indigenous Youth Roots, is planning a free program in Iqaluit, from Oct. 19 to 23, that follows a similar program it ran in Inuvik in June.


Both are pilot projects. The goal is to eventually offer the program regularly — and in more communities.


The program will bring together 10 Indigenous youth in Iqaluit between the ages of 18 and 29 to learn how policy affects their lives and how they can shape it.


Arnatsiaq Qvist, a Northern Policy School specialist from Uummannaq, Greenland, said the organization consulted youth and community members in Inuvik, Yellowknife, Whitehorse, Fredericton, N.B., and Ottawa, while it developed the course last year.


“Many of those northern youth participants voiced a need for additional opportunities for youth in the North that are more accessible and specifically focused on the unique issues based in the North,” Qvist said. 


The curriculum for the Iqaluit session will be adapted to Nunavut, she said. 


One day will focus on the Nunavut Land Claims Agreement and have a local guest speaker.

Another day, participants will work in groups to develop and present a policy request based on a Nunavut-specific case study.


Starr MacLean, a youth advisory committee member from Coral Harbour, is one of the youth who helped shape the program’s curriculum.


“Policy can be really intimidating but it impacts our everyday lives,” said MacLean. “The way the program is developed is that it’s accessible for everybody, so it’s not scary going into it.”


MacLean, who is pursuing a master’s degree in educational policy studies with a specialization in Indigenous peoples’ education at the University of Alberta, said the program has also allowed her to connect her education with Nunavut.


Her work focuses in part on access to post-secondary education for Inuit students.


“Most times we think youth are the future, but youth are also the now,” said MacLean.

“Having youth in those conversations and bringing in their knowledge can help show them how their perspectives are valuable, and that they can have a role in creating change.”


Organizers heard during outreach that policy discussions can be emotionally heavy, which made time on the land with elders, culture and relationship-building important parts of the program, Qvist said.


The course will run from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. each day, and

those who complete it will receive a $1,000 honorarium.


It is open to Indigenous youth in Iqaluit, as the organization cannot provide flights or accommodations, according to its website.


Qvist said youth should apply by Sept. 14, even if they do not consider themselves knowledgeable about policy.


“The way we see it is that lived experience is experience.”

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Inukjuak man charged after fatal stabbing of woman
content:
A 45-year-old man has been charged with the murder of a woman after he arrived at a police station in Inukjuak on Monday to report he had committed a crime. 


Police officers found the victim at a home in the community with stab wounds, Quebec police told Nunatsiaq News. She was rushed to the local health centre, where she was pronounced dead.


The man, 45-year-old Charlie Palliser,

 is charged with first degree murder. He appeared

Wednesday

 before a judge via teleconference.


Court documents identify the woman as 41-year-old Elisabeth Qumak, described as being Palliser’s “intimate partner.”


The

minimum sentence for a first-degree murder in Canada is an automatic life sentence with no eligibility for parole for 25 years.


Court documents also reveal the same man is also facing a break and enter and assault charge from an incident on July 17.

author: Tom Midlane
title: Meta Agrees $17bn Settlement Over Teen Social Media Addiction
content:
Meta has agreed to pay up to $17bn to settle a lawsuit accusing it of creating addicting products that harm teenagers and children. 


The case, which was brought by a number of US states, claimed Meta used its platforms “to entice, engage, and ultimately ensnare youth and teens.”


Meta admits no wrongdoing as part of the settlement but must now introduce a number of safety measures, including a two-hour daily time limit for teenagers, stronger parental controls, and restricted access for children during school hours.


The size of the settlement paid out by Meta – which owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp – was hailed as a “monumental public health victory” by District of Columbia attorney general Brian Schwalb, the

BBC reported

. 


Schwalb said: “The safety features Meta is required to install will fundamentally and immediately change how young people use Instagram and Facebook.”


Other enforced features include a block on usage between midnight and 6am, tougher age verification systems for underage users and reminders after every 15 minutes of continuous use. 


Meta claimed that the settlement would build on its “longstanding efforts to empower parents and support teens”, adding that the funds would be distributed in annual installments to be spent on youth online safety initiatives.


Meta also called on other social platforms, including YouTube and TikTok, to adopt similar restrictions that would “ensure teens use social media in a healthy and responsible way”.

author: A.N.A.
title: [Espanha] O anarquismo revolucionário da manada: Na Extremadura, 60 cavalos selvagens vivem sem líderes, sem selas e sem donos, e estão reescrevendo tudo o que acreditávamos saber
content:
Uma manada que galopa livre pelas serras do norte de Cáceres, seus cascos marcando um ritmo ancestral sobre a terra, suas crinas ao vento sem que nenhuma mão humana as tenha tocado jamais. Não há selas de montar, nem focinheiras, nem cabrestos. Não há hierarquias nem machos alfa impondo sua lei. Lucy Rees, uma etóloga galesa de 82 anos que viajou por meio mundo, observa desde a distância estes cavalos de raça pottoka, naturais do País Vasco, que vivem em total liberdade em uma fazenda de mil hectares, como um laboratório vivo que desafia tudo o que a doma tradicional ensinou. Seu projeto, que completa 14 anos, não é um simples santuário; é uma heresia ética e científica que questiona a essência de nossa relação com os animais: a ideia de que devem ser controlados, dominados e dobrados à nossa vontade. Esta não é uma imagem da natureza selvagem, mas a de uma revolução silenciosa que nos devolve o olhar de um ser que não nos necessita.


Este projeto de “renaturalização” não é um capricho romântico, mas um alerta contra o dogma equestre que imperou durante séculos. É o mesmo calafrio que produz descobrir que os chimpanzés são seres racionais, mas aqui a lição se aplica a uma das espécies que mais tivemos por perto: o cavalo. Rees, que trabalhou com cavalos de competição de elite, viveu uma ruptura total ao ver animais “loucos por viver em condições antinaturais”. Sua conclusão é demolidora: a doma tradicional é “uma forma de escravidão baseada na dor”. E sua proposta, baseada na observação de cavalos que vivem em um ecossistema natural, desmonta mitos fundamentais: não há uma hierarquia de dominância, mas uma organização “completamente anarquista” onde cada indivíduo tem um papel e coopera ante o perigo real. É uma estrutura social sem chefes, que funciona com uma inteligência coletiva que a doma, ao impor uma figura de autoridade, destrói. Os cavalos de Rees não tem enfermidades nem tratamentos; sua saúde é “impressionante”, um testemunho de que a liberdade é o melhor veterinário. A observação destes animais, sem montaria nem chicotes nem ginetes, se convertem em um espelho de nossa cegueira: Estamos há décadas olhando os cavalos sem vê-los realmente, impondo-lhes nossos preconceitos sobre a dominação.


As raízes desta cegueira se fundem na mesma lógica extrativista e antropocêntrica que nos leva a ver os animais como recursos. A doma tradicional, com sua ênfase no controle e na submissão, é um reflexo de uma cultura que valoriza a utilidade sobre a dignidade, o rendimento sobre o bem estar. A crítica de Rees, que denuncia que estamos ensinando as crianças que “se um ser vivo não faz o que você quer, é preciso que apanhe”, é uma acusação profunda a nossa pedagogia da violência. O projeto em Extremadura, que atrai visitantes de todo o mundo, não só oferece um curso de etologia; oferece uma terapia para desaprender o domínio. Quando pessoas com décadas de experiência equestre admitem, após observar estes cavalos livres, que “não sabiam nada”, se produz um terremoto epistemológico. Se desmorona a ideia de que o ser humano é o centro e o dono da natureza, e se abre a possibilidade de uma relação baseada no respeito e na compreensão, não na imposição. É a mesma desconexão cultural que nos leva a ver um elefante em um depósito sem compreender que somos nós que criamos o depósito e que despojamos o elefante de sua liberdade.


E no entanto, a esperança que emana deste projeto é tão tangível como o ar da serra. A renaturalização não é uma utopia; é uma prática que demonstra que os ecossistemas podem recuperar-se e que os animais podem florescer sem nossa intervenção coercitiva. O trabalho de Rees é um modelo para repensar a pecuária, a conservação e nossa ética animal. A ideia de que os cavalos não necessitam ser domados, mas observados e respeitados, é uma semente que pode germinar em outros âmbitos. Se aplicamos esta filosofia à forma em que tratamos os animais de granja, os animais em cativeiro e à fauna silvestre, estaríamos dando um passo gigante para uma coabitação mais justa. O fato de que o projeto tenha ganho reconhecimento internacional e atraia pessoas da Argentina à Alemanha, é um indício de que a troca de olhar é possível. A advertência de Rees de que os cavalos não estão para serem acariciados, alimentados ou montados, é uma lição de humildade: a verdadeira admiração, diz, é a que não busca possuir. “Tocar-lhes só satisfaz o ego humano”, sentencia.
